t: Luceco Outdoor LED Solar Wall Light provides bright, energy-efficient illumination for enhanced property security and visibility. Ideal for installations where mains power wiring is challenging or costly, such as garden sheds, garages, and remote pathways. The wall-mounted unit features integrated LEDs, delivering 220 lumens of cool white 4000K light. Solar-powered operation simplifies installation, requiring no transformer or complex wiring. A pre-set dusk-to-dawn sensor ensures automatic function, while the PIR motion sensor detects movement across a 120° angle up to 6m. Durable polycarbonate construction with an IP65 rating withstands outdoor elements, and fixings are supplied.
